title: Pharaoh Ramesses II the Great (Usermaatre)
kingdom: New Kingdom of Egypt (The Imperial Age)
biography: Reigned for 66 glorious years as Egypt's greatest monument builder. Fought the Hittites at the Battle of Kadesh and signed the world's first recorded international peace treaty, constructing the colossal temples of Abu Simbel and the Ramesseum.
internationalConnections: Concluded the Egyptian-Hittite Peace Treaty with Hattusili III, marrying a Hittite princess.
